AirportDelayAlert.description:
AirportDelayAlert represents a flight delay advisory at an airport.
 Sourced from FAA and Eurocontrol.

city.description: City where the airport is located.

delayType.description: FlightDelayType represents the type of flight delay.

region.description: AirportRegion represents the geographic region of an airport.

severity.description:
FlightDelaySeverity represents the severity of flight delays at an airport.
 Maps to TS union: 'normal' | 'minor' | 'moderate' | 'major' | 'severe' | 'unknown'.

source.description: FlightDelaySource represents the source of delay data.

updatedAt.description: Last data update time, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

AviationNewsItem.description: AviationNewsItem represents a single aviation news article or press release.

items.description: Entities matched from the query (airport codes, airline names).

publishedAt.description: Publication time as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

Carrier.description: Carrier represents an airline or aircraft operator.

DatePriceEntry.description: DatePriceEntry pairs a departure date (and optional return date) with its cheapest price.

returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format; empty for one-way results.

EmergencyFeed.description: EmergencyFeed records success and failure separately for each exact code query.

fetchedAt.description: Retrieval time in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

EmergencyObservation.description: EmergencyObservation is a reported Mode A code, not a confirmed incident.

address.description: Provider address, including a non-ICAO prefix when present.

aircraftType.description: Provider type code, empty when unknown.

altitudeFt.description: Barometric altitude in feet, absent when unknown or reported as ground.

description.description: Provider aircraft description, empty when unknown.

groundSpeedKts.description: Ground speed in knots, absent when unknown.

militaryFlag.description: Military database bit, set, not_set, or unknown. This is not admission criteria.

observedAt.description: Last message time in epoch milliseconds, not squawk selection time. Zero means unknown.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

EmergencyPosition.description: EmergencyPosition keeps the position clock separate from last contact.

observedAt.description: Provider position time in epoch milliseconds. Zero means unknown.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

GeoCoordinates.description: GeoCoordinates represents a geographic location using WGS84 coordinates.

GetYoutubeLiveStreamInfoRequest.description: GetYoutubeLiveStreamInfoRequest names the YouTube video to look up.

channel.description: Deprecated: YouTube channel handle or ID. Channel live detection is retired; a channel-only query returns error "channel_live_detection_retired".

GetYoutubeLiveStreamInfoResponse.description: GetYoutubeLiveStreamInfoResponse containing the oEmbed lookup result.

channelExists.description: Deprecated: true only when the oEmbed lookup succeeded, so it now carries exactly error == "".

error.description: "channel_live_detection_retired" for a channel-only query, or why the video lookup failed.

hlsUrl.description: Always empty: YouTube manifest URLs are no longer returned.

isLive.description: Always false: oEmbed does not report whether a video is live.

videoId.description: Video ID that was looked up.

GoogleFlightLeg.description: GoogleFlightLeg represents a single flight segment (one plane, one takeoff and landing).

GoogleFlightResult.description: GoogleFlightResult represents a complete itinerary (one or more legs).

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

ListAircraftEmergenciesRequest.description: ListAircraftEmergenciesRequest has no filters. Coverage is provider reception.

ListAircraftEmergenciesResponse.description: ListAircraftEmergenciesResponse preserves observations and per-query availability.

ListAirportDelaysRequest.description: ListAirportDelaysRequest specifies filters for retrieving airport delay alerts.

cursor.description:
Cursor for next page.
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

minSeverity.description:
FlightDelaySeverity represents the severity of flight delays at an airport.
 Maps to TS union: 'normal' | 'minor' | 'moderate' | 'major' | 'severe' | 'unknown'.

pageSize.description:
Maximum items per page (1-100).
 Accepted but currently ignored; no-op until this handler supports the parameter.

region.description: AirportRegion represents the geographic region of an airport.

ListAirportDelaysResponse.description: ListAirportDelaysResponse contains airport delay alerts matching the request.

ListAviationNewsRequest.description: ListAviationNewsRequest specifies filters for aviation news retrieval.

items.description: Entities to filter by (airline names, airport codes, route strings).

maxItems.description: Maximum number of news items to return (1-50).

windowHours.description: Time window in hours to look back (1-168).

ListAviationNewsResponse.description: ListAviationNewsResponse contains filtered aviation news items.

updatedAt.description: Last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

PaginationResponse.description: PaginationResponse contains pagination metadata returned alongside list results.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page. Empty string indicates no more pages.

totalCount.description: Total count of items matching the query, if known. Zero if the total is unknown.

PositionSample.description: PositionSample represents a single aircraft position observation.

observedAt.description: Observation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

onGround.description: Whether the aircraft is on the ground.

source.description: PositionSource identifies the provider of aircraft position data.

trackDeg.description: True track over ground in degrees (0 = North, clockwise).

verticalRate.description: Vertical rate in metres per second (positive = climbing).

PriceQuote.description: PriceQuote represents a single flight price offer from a provider.

cabin.description: CabinClass represents the travel class for a flight ticket.

checkoutRef.description: Reference used during the checkout process (for follow-up actions).

expiresAt.description: Time when this quote expires, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

isIndicative.description: Whether the price is indicative rather than bookable.

observedAt.description: Time when this quote was observed, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

SearchFlightPricesRequest.description: SearchFlightPricesRequest specifies parameters for a flight price search.

adults.description:
Number of adult passengers (1-9).
 Accepted but currently ignored; quotes are per-person and the count does not filter.

cabin.description: CabinClass represents the travel class for a flight ticket.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of quotes to return (1-50).

nonstopOnly.description: Whether to restrict to nonstop flights only.

degraded.description:
True when the live provider could not satisfy the request — missing
 credentials, upstream failure, or zero results. Mirrors the
 searchGoogleFlights pattern so clients can render distinct messages
 for each error class.

error.description:
Discriminator for the degraded state: "" (ok), "missing_credentials"
 (TRAVELPAYOUTS_API_TOKEN unset), "upstream_error" (provider call
 threw), "no_results" (provider returned empty for this route).

isDemoMode.description:
Whether results are from demo/simulated mode. Requires explicit
 AVIATION_DEMO_PRICES=1 opt-in on the server. Never true in default
 self-host / production runs. See issue #3756.

isIndicative.description: Whether returned prices are indicative (subject to change).

provider.description:
Provider name: "travelpayouts_data", "demo", or "none" when no live
 provider is configured.

updatedAt.description: Last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

SearchGoogleDatesRequest.description: SearchGoogleDatesRequest specifies parameters for a Google Flights date-range price search.

items.description: Airline IATA codes to filter by (e.g. ["BA", "AA"]).

cabinClass.description: Cabin class: ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS, or FIRST.

departureWindow.description: Departure time window in HH-HH format (e.g. "6-20").

endDate.description: End of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

isRoundTrip.description: Whether to search for round-trip flights.

maxStops.description: Stop filter: ANY, NON_STOP, ONE_STOP, or TWO_PLUS_STOPS.

sortByPrice.description: Whether to sort results by price (lowest first).

startDate.description: Start of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tripDuration.description: Trip duration in days (required for round-trip searches).

SearchGoogleDatesResponse.description: SearchGoogleDatesResponse contains cheapest-date results from Google Flights.

SearchGoogleFlightsRequest.description: SearchGoogleFlightsRequest specifies parameters for a Google Flights search.

items.description: Airline IATA codes to filter by (e.g. ["BA", "AA"]).

cabinClass.description: Cabin class: ECONOMY, PREMIUM_ECONOMY, BUSINESS, or FIRST.

departureWindow.description: Departure time window in HH-HH format (e.g. "6-20").

maxStops.description: Stop filter: ANY, NON_STOP, ONE_STOP, or TWO_PLUS_STOPS.

returnDate.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format; omit for one-way.

sortBy.description: Sort order: CHEAPEST, DURATION, DEPARTURE_TIME, or ARRIVAL_TIME.

SearchGoogleFlightsResponse.description: SearchGoogleFlightsResponse contains flight results from Google Flights.

TrackAircraftRequest.description: TrackAircraftRequest specifies an aircraft to track.

updatedAt.description: Last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.
